node.statement: Let P_j:=W_jW_j^*, let iota_j0(z):=z tensor xi_j, and use bold symbols for q-amplifications. From Delta(X)=sum_k W_k^*(X_k tensor I_Ek)W_k in lem-routef-upsilon-prime-component-construction and the fact that hat-U_js Y hat-U_jt^* has only block j nonzero, Delta_q(hat-U_js Y hat-U_jt^*)=W_j,q^*[(bold-U_js Y_j bold-U_jt^*) tensor I_Ej]W_j,q. Substitution in P_jq(Y), with iota_js=(U_js tensor I_Ej)iota_j0, gives P_jq(Y)=iota_j0,q^* [sum_s p_js bold-U_js^* P_j,q bold-U_js] (Y_j tensor I_Ej) [sum_t p_jt bold-U_jt^* P_j,q bold-U_jt] iota_j0,q.
node.inference: block formula from lem-routef-upsilon-prime-component-construction and finite double-sum factorization
